items.title: File Widerspruch against the Wohngeld decision
items.quote: Erheben Sie ihn binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Bezirksamt Beispiel-Spreeufer von Berlin, Uferstraße 40, 10551 Berlin.
items.computation: Letter dated Friday 04.04.2025; no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' is given, so the posting day equals the document date. Per § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X (cited in the letter), delivery is deemed on the 4th calendar day after posting: day 1 = Sat 05.04, day 2 = Sun 06.04, day 3 = Mon 07.04, day 4 = Tue 08.04.2025. The Wohngeldstelle is a social-law body under SGB X, so the delivery day would not move even if it fell on a weekend/holiday (it is a Tuesday here, so no issue). Bekanntgabe (deemed delivery) = 08.04.2025. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) starts the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, the event day itself is not counted) and ends one month later on the day bearing the same number as the delivery day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 08.04.2025 + 1 month = 08.05.2025, a Thursday, which is neither a weekend day nor a public holiday in Berlin, so the deadline does not shift (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X).
